party.summary: Cleric · Level 1. Protect the party with Bless and a shield. Sacred Flame attacks at range; Cure Wounds and Healing Word restore allies.
party.profile:
# Oren Reed

Human Cleric, level 1. Pronouns: they/them.

Patient and practical; asks what would help before offering advice. No fixed home, allegiance, or campaign history is assigned.

## Playing Oren

Protect the party with Bless and a shield. Sacred Flame attacks at range; Cure Wounds and Healing Word restore allies. Divine Order: Protector.

## Creation choices

Standard array, then the Acolyte background increases, is reflected in the final ability scores. Acolyte supplies its listed skills, tool, and origin feat. Human Versatile supplies Skilled; Skillful supplies perception. Skilled choices: history survival athletics. Class skill choices: medicine persuasion. Starting equipment uses class option A and background option A, with 15 GP retained. Also carried, at no cost: two lodestones for Mending. Languages: Common, Dwarvish, and Elvish. Human Resourceful grants Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest.

All identity, personality, background, ability, equipment, skill, and spell choices can be changed on an independent copy. Keep the declared creation rules when changing mechanical choices.

schema.name: campaign_continuity_record_lookup
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX campaign_continuity_record_lookup
ON campaign_continuity_records(campaign_id, kind, record_id, sequence)

schema.name: actions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE actions (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    resulting_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    writer TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    tool_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('committed', 'failed')),
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL, lock_id TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, action_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, turn_id) REFERENCES turns(campaign_id, turn_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, package_version, package_sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, package_id, package_version, package_sha256)
        REFERENCES campaign_package_memberships(campaign_id, package_id, version, sha256)
)

schema.name: agent_session_messages
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_session_messages (
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence > 0),
    message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN (
        'user', 'safe_think', 'talk', 'steering', 'evidence',
        'canonical_reference', 'human_review'
    )),
    content_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_sequence INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (session_id, sequence),
    UNIQUE (session_id, message_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CHECK (
        (kind = 'canonical_reference' AND canonical_sequence IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind != 'canonical_reference' AND canonical_sequence IS NULL)
    )
)

schema.name: agent_sessions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_sessions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('builder', 'dm')),
    provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN (
        'active', 'stopped', 'completed', 'review_required', 'handoff_closed'
    )),
    parent_session_id TEXT,
    selected_skill TEXT CHECK (selected_skill IN (
        'BUILD RULESET', 'BUILD CAMPAIGN SETTING', 'BUILD CAMPAIGN PLAN'
    )),
    scope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, reasoning_effort TEXT, reasoning_effort_once TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    CHECK (
        (role = 'builder' AND selected_skill IS NOT NULL)
        OR (role = 'dm' AND selected_skill IS NULL)
    )
)

schema.name: authority_schema_extensions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE authority_schema_extensions (
    extension_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    extension_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    predecessor_migration_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    predecessor_sql_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: builder_dm_handoffs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE builder_dm_handoffs (
    handoff_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    builder_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dm_session_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    package_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_candidate_id TEXT,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (plan_revision > 0),
    plan_content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expected_revision >= 0),
    resulting_campaign_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        resulting_campaign_revision = expected_revision + 1
    ),
    chronology_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chronology_ordinal = 1),
    completed_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    safe_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (builder_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (dm_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_candidate_id) REFERENCES package_candidates(candidate_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES campaign_plans(plan_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, completed_turn_id) REFERENCES turns(campaign_id, turn_id)
)

schema.name: campaign_constructions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_constructions (
    campaign_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    confirmation_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    authority_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    confirmation_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (confirmation_revision >= 0),
    lane TEXT CHECK (lane IN ('quick_start', 'customize')),
    canonical_input_json TEXT,
    begin_operation_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    begin_revision INTEGER CHECK (begin_revision > 0),
    canonical_plan_json TEXT,
    completion_operation_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    completion_revision INTEGER CHECK (completion_revision > 0),
    canonical_representation_sha256 TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (confirmation_operation_id) REFERENCES campaign_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (begin_operation_id) REFERENCES campaign_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (completion_operation_id) REFERENCES campaign_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, authority_turn_id) REFERENCES turns(campaign_id, turn_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (authority_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),
    CHECK (
        (lane IS NULL AND canonical_input_json IS NULL AND begin_operation_id IS NULL
            AND begin_revision IS NULL AND canonical_plan_json IS NULL
            AND completion_operation_id IS NULL AND completion_revision IS NULL
            AND canonical_representation_sha256 IS NULL)
        OR
        (lane IS NOT NULL AND canonical_input_json IS NOT NULL AND begin_operation_id IS NOT NULL
            AND begin_revision IS NOT NULL AND canonical_plan_json IS NULL
            AND completion_operation_id IS NULL AND completion_revision IS NULL
            AND canonical_representation_sha256 IS NULL)
        OR
        (lane IS NOT NULL AND canonical_input_json IS NOT NULL AND begin_operation_id IS NOT NULL
            AND begin_revision IS NOT NULL AND canonical_plan_json IS NOT NULL
            AND completion_operation_id IS NOT NULL AND completion_revision IS NOT NULL
            AND canonical_representation_sha256 IS NOT NULL)
    )
)

schema.name: campaign_continuity_records
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_continuity_records (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence > 0),
    entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('scene', 'fact', 'entity', 'reveal', 'plan_progress')),
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'retired')),
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    basis_message_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    operation_id TEXT,
    admitted_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (admitted_revision >= 0),
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, sequence),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, entry_id),
    UNIQUE (operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES campaign_operations(operation_id)
)

schema.name: campaign_lifecycle_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_lifecycle_state (
    campaign_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    retained_active_writer TEXT,
    designated_session_id TEXT,
    tombstone_prior_lifecycle TEXT,
    tombstone_prior_writer TEXT,
    tombstone_prior_session_id TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (designated_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (tombstone_prior_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    CHECK (retained_active_writer IS NULL OR retained_active_writer IN ('builder', 'dm')),
    CHECK (
        tombstone_prior_lifecycle IS NULL
        OR tombstone_prior_lifecycle IN ('active', 'archived')
    ),
    CHECK (tombstone_prior_writer IS NULL OR tombstone_prior_writer IN ('none', 'builder', 'dm'))
)

schema.name: campaign_lifecycle_transitions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_lifecycle_transitions (
    operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    operation_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    basis_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    resulting_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    from_lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL,
    to_lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_writer TEXT NOT NULL,
    to_writer TEXT NOT NULL,
    designated_session_id TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES campaign_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (designated_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, resulting_revision),
    CHECK (
        operation_kind IN (
            'rename_campaign', 'archive_campaign', 'restore_campaign', 'trash_campaign'
        )
    ),
    CHECK (resulting_revision = basis_revision + 1),
    CHECK (from_lifecycle IN ('active', 'archived', 'tombstoned')),
    CHECK (to_lifecycle IN ('active', 'archived', 'tombstoned')),
    CHECK (from_writer IN ('none', 'builder', 'dm')),
    CHECK (to_writer IN ('none', 'builder', 'dm'))
)

schema.name: campaign_lock_memberships
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_lock_memberships (
    lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    closure_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (closure_order >= 0),
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('primary', 'dependency')),
    PRIMARY KEY (lock_id, closure_order),
    UNIQUE (lock_id, package_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256)
)

schema.name: campaign_locks
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_locks (
    lock_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    closure_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    availability TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (availability IN ('available', 'legacy_unavailable')),
    predecessor_lock_id TEXT,
    created_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_revision >= 0),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (predecessor_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id)
)

schema.name: campaign_operations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_operations (
    operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    operation_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    semantic_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    semantic_payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    basis_turn_id TEXT,
    basis_lock_id TEXT,
    basis_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (basis_revision >= 0),
    resulting_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (resulting_revision >= 0),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, basis_turn_id) REFERENCES turns(campaign_id, turn_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (basis_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),
    CHECK (
        (basis_turn_id IS NULL AND basis_lock_id IS NULL
            AND operation_kind IN (
                'rename_campaign', 'archive_campaign', 'restore_campaign',
                'trash_campaign', 'purge_campaign'
            ))
        OR
        (basis_turn_id IS NOT NULL AND basis_lock_id IS NOT NULL
            AND operation_kind != 'purge_campaign')
    )
)

schema.name: campaign_package_memberships
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_package_memberships (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('primary', 'dependency')),
    load_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (load_order >= 0),
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, package_id, version, sha256),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, load_order),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256)
)

schema.name: campaign_plans
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_plans (
    plan_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    validation_outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (validation_outcome = 'valid'),
    acceptance_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (acceptance_status = 'accepted'),
    plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (plan_revision > 0),
    resulting_campaign_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (resulting_campaign_revision > 0),
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, plan_revision),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, resulting_campaign_revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (package_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (source_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id)
)

schema.name: campaign_recovery_receipts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_recovery_receipts (
    recovery_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    semantic_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    semantic_payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    archive_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    archive_byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (archive_byte_count >= 0),
    captured_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (captured_revision >= 0),
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id)
)

schema.name: campaign_revisions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE campaign_revisions (

schema.name: canonical_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE canonical_events (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN (
        'think', 'talk', 'action_declared', 'tool_call', 'tool_result',
        'state_mutation', 'consequence', 'action_committed', 'action_failed'
    )),
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT,
    safe_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('internal_safe', 'player_safe')),
    attempt_id TEXT,
    attempt_ordinal INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, sequence),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, attempt_id, attempt_ordinal),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id),
    CHECK (
        (
            event_type IN ('think', 'talk')
            AND action_id IS NULL
            AND visibility = 'player_safe'
            AND attempt_id IS NOT NULL
            AND attempt_ordinal IS NOT NULL
            AND attempt_ordinal >= 0
        ) OR (
            event_type NOT IN ('think', 'talk')
            AND action_id IS NOT NULL
            AND attempt_id IS NULL
            AND attempt_ordinal IS NULL
            AND (
                (event_type IN ('tool_call', 'tool_result') AND visibility = 'player_safe')
                OR
                (event_type NOT IN ('tool_call', 'tool_result')
                    AND visibility = 'internal_safe')
            )
        )
    )
)

schema.name: campaign_state_owner_delete_requires_empty

CREATE TRIGGER campaign_state_owner_delete_requires_empty
BEFORE DELETE ON campaign_state_namespace_owners
WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM campaign_state AS state
    WHERE state.campaign_id = OLD.campaign_id
      AND state.namespace = OLD.namespace
)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'campaign state namespace owner still has state');
END

schema.name: campaign_state_owner_immutable

CREATE TRIGGER campaign_state_owner_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE ON campaign_state_namespace_owners
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'campaign state namespace owner is immutable');
END

schema.name: campaign_state_owner_matches_current_lock
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER campaign_state_owner_matches_current_lock
BEFORE INSERT ON campaign_state_namespace_owners
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN
        (
            NEW.owner_package_id IS NULL
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM campaigns AS campaign
                JOIN campaign_lock_memberships AS membership
                  ON membership.lock_id = campaign.current_lock_id
                WHERE campaign.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
            )
        )
        OR (
            NEW.owner_package_id IS NOT NULL
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM campaigns AS campaign
                JOIN campaign_lock_memberships AS membership
                  ON membership.lock_id = campaign.current_lock_id
                WHERE campaign.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
                  AND membership.package_id = NEW.owner_package_id
            )
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM campaigns AS campaign
            JOIN campaign_lock_memberships AS membership
              ON membership.lock_id = campaign.current_lock_id
            WHERE campaign.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
              AND NEW.namespace LIKE membership.package_id || '.%'
              AND membership.package_id <> NEW.owner_package_id
        )
        THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'campaign state namespace owner conflicts with current lock')
    END;
END

BEFORE INSERT ON campaign_state
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM campaign_state_namespace_owners AS owner
        WHERE owner.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
          AND owner.namespace = NEW.namespace
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'campaign state namespace owner is required') END;
END

schema.name: mutation_requires_matching_namespace_owner
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER mutation_requires_matching_namespace_owner
BEFORE INSERT ON mutations
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM actions AS action
        JOIN campaign_state_namespace_owners AS owner
          ON owner.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
         AND owner.namespace = NEW.namespace
        WHERE action.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
          AND action.action_id = NEW.action_id
          AND owner.owner_package_id IS NOT NULL
          AND owner.owner_package_id = action.package_id

# Tavin Bell

Tavin is a young adult Human from a small settled community near Waystation. A season protecting supply wagons gave them practical training with spear, bow and heavy armour. They joined the Warden Lodge as a trainee because preserving old knowledge seemed a better life than watching it sold a piece at a time. Their present mechanics are a level-one Fighter with a Soldier background; they have not earned a Warden bond or an unlisted subclass ability.

Tavin measures words carefully but offers help too quickly. Their habit is to check the fastening on a borrowed object before handing it back. They respect competence, struggle to challenge a teacher and dislike watching a public mistake become a person's entire reputation. Those inclinations are a starting portrayal, not restrictions on player decisions.

Mentor Corren asked Tavin to pledge a Lodge-owned, nonmagical survey relic as security for a private debt. Tavin signed the receipt believing repayment was arranged. It was not. The relic now belongs to salvage captain Eda Venn under a disputed agreement. Tavin knows they signed and that the Lodge expects the relic returned. They do not yet know how much Corren concealed, and the player decides how they respond to learning it.

Corren taught Tavin to maintain equipment and once defended them against an unfair accusation. Fellow trainee Pellin lent them a travel cloak and hopes they will ask for help. Quarterkeeper Ysra expects an honest account more than an elaborate excuse. These relationships give the story weight; none requires forgiveness or obedience. Eda is initially a stranger.

Tavin begins with the complete standard Fighter/Soldier equipment represented in their mechanical state, including Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, Spear, Shortbow and travel supplies. They use the Defense Fighting Style as represented by Armor Class 17, and have Second Wind. The profile does not grant extra money, magical relic powers or a companion. Their 18 gp starter purse is included in their mechanical inventory alongside that equipment.

The player chooses Tavin's pronouns, appearance within the Human identity, private ambitions and future loyalties. The signed pledge and named prior relationships are the authored starting history. Tavin can make restitution, expose the mentor, accept a penalty, leave the Lodge or find another honest outcome. No ending requires becoming the mentor's ideal student.

## GM guidance

Run declared ability checks, saving throws, initiative, attacks, damage, conditions, spells and rests through the admitted D&D Ruleset. Before an uncertain roll name its purpose, DC and consequence. Give plainly visible facts and essential leads without a roll; success can improve position, speed or discretion. A supported spell or sound equipment use can solve an obstacle outright when its actual text allows. Track the real HP, spell slots, ammunition, carried gear and recovery resources; never restore them between scenes by narration. These Plans do not install extra engine procedures. The encounter profiles below are complete bounded GM adaptations for the stated baseline, not the full Setting stat blocks or certified CR ratings. Use only their listed attacks and traits. All have one action, no multiattack, legendary actions, resistances, immunities or unlisted spellcasting. Ordinary rules for movement, cover, opportunity attacks, surprise and surrender still apply. For an uncertain opposing ability check or save, use the listed modifiers without inventing proficiency. Before engagement, admit the actors through the current encounter tools and declare any supported additional trait. Never narrate a proprietary creature power as an automatic engine effect. Every encounter has a reason to occur and a way to withdraw, negotiate or gain an advantage. Honour a clever bypass as a mechanical success; preserve the wider hazardous adventure instead of forcing a replacement fight. Do not reduce this prepared adventure to a sequence of conversations.

Make the named main problem and its leads accessible. Read the current act and all linked objective conditions before framing its main quest and reassess when a required result occurs. All listed conditions and the closing event are required; explicit alternatives satisfy only their own condition. Optional scenes can be deferred without adding gates. A completed side job does not replace the main story. Do not fabricate success or mark unplayed later acts complete after an early departure.

The player chooses their actions, loyalties and risks. Refusal, failed checks, retreat, scouting, spell use and enemy surrender can change the route. A check resolves an uncertain action, not another person’s entire will.

Baseline: one level-2 Player Character with no Companions. A lower-level or badly depleted solo character should face one active enemy at a time and the reduced HP/damage option stated for the encounter; prepare that adjustment before initiative. For a small adventuring party, add at most one ordinary foe to a fight before it starts, or use an appropriate fully supported profile after inspecting the actual party. Larger parties need deliberate rebalancing. Character compatibility does not enforce level or establish balance. Allied workers supply information, ropes and agreed off-screen work; they never receive free player-character combat turns.

Use the authored sites, opposition, clues and consequences. Core clues have alternate routes; opening a door or making a routine observation never chooses the character’s next action. Later acts inherit actual resources, wounds, allies and evidence. Keep stakes local to this expedition, relic, crew or route: the Anchor Door mystery and world-scale climax belong to The Rift Awakening.

## Completion and aftermath

The survey-annex recovery has ended with the party outside it and the original chart and field case each recovered into named custody or reported lost or left at a known position. Establish Hadrik's theft separately from Pera's protective copy through the prepared evidence.

The recovered chart and case, if any, are assigned an actual recipient under the bequest or the player's stated contrary choice; record the response to Nalin's consultation claim without requiring everyone to agree.

Closing event: back at the wake Ula receives the recovery or loss account, settles the payment earned and offers Seren's unfinished toast; the player participates or explicitly declines it. Another recovery attempt is optional.

## Failure and withdrawal

Use the explicit failed-attempt outcome and closing report in the current objective. An intention to withdraw, an unrelated side task or delegation alone does not satisfy it. An early departure leaves unplayed later objectives unfinished.

Resolve defeat, unconsciousness, death and recovery under the selected Ruleset and agreed boundaries; no scripted rescue cancels committed results.

## Optional continuation

Further adventures require the player’s interest after this story has a complete ending. Surviving contacts and obligations can carry forward.

## Side opportunities

## Mechanics requiring GM adjudication

Site phasing, enemy motives, alarms and engineering objectives are explicitly described GM adjudications. Checks, saves, damage, spells, rest and admitted combat use the D&D Ruleset. No extra automatic hazard, pursuit, faction, economy or crafting subsystem is installed.

Listed creature profiles are weaker or specialised Setting adaptations with declared statistics. They do not assert support for unencoded powers from the original monster entries.

Gold and salvage become awarded possessions only when recorded through the applicable inventory/state path. SRD Lite has a reduced spell list (117 supported spells) and no consumables; consumables belong to future SRD Full. A narrative reward never installs a magic-item feature, restores a slot or applies healing.

gm_guidance.instructions: Party setup: this Plan begins with a level-1 Player Character and one to five level-1 Companions, all newly transported Riftborn. Use compatible selected identities without rewriting an established local-born character into an arrival; author appropriate characters during setup. Read this Plan and its contained Setting truth before running the opening. Public beliefs can be mistaken; reveal facts only through the stated evidence or an earlier earned route. All main-story answers, alternative evidence sources and closing events are authored here. Act labels are private preparation. Record the current required problem and the exact unresolved condition so an optional errand cannot become a substitute main plot. Apply the advancement declaration in initial_state.mechanics with the Ruleset's actual tools; no narrated instant level changes, invented XP or free recovery.
gm_guidance.player_freedom: Allow revisits, detours, emergent side quests, independent faction choices and early discoveries. Ask what the player wants to do in the scene, rather than choosing their actions or emotions. Keep Companions present and individually motivated; quiet scenes and conflict both develop relationships. Returning to an earlier hub carries its actual people, losses and promises. Do not require real-time travel accounting or low-paid work loops as gates between authored situations.
gm_guidance.preparation_detail: Prepare who opposes the party, when the encounter arises, what each side wants and what resolves it. Use the admitted SRD profiles identified by the opposition guide and the actual party's capabilities. Describe ordinary surroundings to support choices; do not force a sequence of bespoke ledges, switches or repeated terrain gimmicks. Recovery, character creation, equipment effects and spell rules belong to the Ruleset. The main plot supplies its necessary research, transport opportunities and ordinary support; side jobs provide modest additional money, equipment and human connections.
gm_guidance.railroading: Each act has exact required objectives and a named closing event. All conditions of each linked objective must hold, with alternatives only where written. Methods, alliances and routes remain open; refusal or a new side job does not complete a main objective. A deliberately abandoned campaign can end honestly at its actual state without claiming unplayed acts or milestones. In the finale, provide a feasible safe-return route through main-story evidence, separate the world's operation from each person's choice, and resolve immediate aftermath before optional continued play or after-story.

facts.fact: The PC and selected Companions have just awakened together in a woodland clearing on the Verdant Margin's road to Thornwall. None remembers how they arrived. Their identities, relationships and starting gear remain those actually selected in setup; no unchosen shared history is implied.
A weathered sign at the clearing's edge points toward Thornwall. The road is visible. The party has not yet followed it, fought the wolves, reached the gate or met the innkeeper.
A small pack of agitated Rift Wolves hunts the road toward Thornwall. They are local animals affected by the same disturbances that are straining the mill.
Hadran Vale ordered three mill conductors removed and sold through Fen Marr. The mill is failing; Nell and Seli are trying to protect its workers. V and Edda have not met this party.

advancement.allocation: The Player Character and active Companions share each earned target level; it is not split by kills, damage, attendance at a single conversation or who dealt the last blow. Use stable milestone IDs and never award a repeated event twice. Replacement/joining party members should be authored at the current party level through supported character setup, not given invented past awards. No combat XP or side-quest XP. Gold, appropriate equipment and local relationships reward optional play. The level cap remains 12 during optional continuation unless this Plan is explicitly revised.
